faq.question: Is toothpaste allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Toothpaste is restricted in carry-on luggage. Toothpaste is classified as a paste/gel and is restricted under liquids rules. Tubes in carry-on must be 3.4 oz (100 ml) or less. Larger tubes must be checked.
